# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

For a MacBook Pro, look for a bank with **100W or more of USB-C Power Delivery** and **under 100Wh** of capacity, which is the airline carry-on limit. The 16-inch Pro fast-charges at 140W, so it needs a PD 3.1 bank. The 14-inch is fine with 100W.

## My picks

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26,250mAh, 300W)**
- It has two 140W USB-C ports, 300W total output, and 99.75Wh capacity, so it is still carry-on legal.
- It recharges quickly (250W input), and Macworld named it best overall.
- Price is about $200-230.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable, two 140W ports, and 99.54Wh capacity.
- It can fast-charge two 16-inch MacBook Pros at once.
- It lists at $219.99, and WIRED shows it at about $190 on Amazon.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html) | [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W)**
- It has a built-in cable rated up to 140W, and its ports are rated at 100W.
- It costs about $120.
- WIRED notes ReelCharge is a new brand, so it's a bit riskier, though it comes with a 3-year warranty.
- [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Budget 140W option: INIU Cougar P64 (140W)**
- Macworld lists it as its best-value 140W bank, but it has no built-in cable and lower total output.
- [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)

**Cheapest 14-inch option: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W)**
- It's about 74Wh, so it's carry-on legal, and it costs $89.99.
- It's fine for a 14-inch Pro but won't fast-charge a 16-inch.
- Baseus doesn't publish how power is split across ports, so expect less than 100W to your laptop if you charge a phone at the same time.
- Dealectric called it the "only" suitable bank, but that only reflects its own limited catalog, not the wider market.
- [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah) (affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy)

## Tips
- **16-inch Pro:** get a 140W PD 3.1 bank like the Anker Prime or EcoFlow, and use a 140W-rated cable. Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable works for fast charging.
- **Realistic capacity:** a ~100Wh bank gives roughly 70-75% of a 16-inch Pro's battery, or about 1.2 charges of a 14-inch Pro, because some energy is lost in transfer.
- **Flying:** stay under 100Wh. Larger banks are generally not allowed on commercial flights.

If you tell me which MacBook Pro you have and your budget, I can narrow it to one pick.
